focal_blueprints.title_zh: 实验证言与性能突破预览段（Quantitative Empirical Preview）
focal_blueprints.user_intent_zh: 我这一段想在 Introduction 结尾前，用三句话硬核总结我们在哪些基准数据集/真实硬件上做了实验，取得了多大幅度的领先。
focal_blueprints.when_to_use_zh: Introduction 倒数第二段（Empirical Validation Preview）
paragraph_move_structure: S1 [评测广度 Scope of Evaluation]：We evaluate [Model] across [N] public benchmarks and [Real-world Hardware/Scenario], spanning [Tasks].
S2 [核心精度突破 Primary Accuracy Gain]：实验主指标对比（必须包含具体百分比、最强基线名称及困难场景表现）。
S3 [效率或泛化突破 Efficiency / Zero-Shot Gain]：报告计算速度、显存占用或零样本跨场景泛化收益。
focal_blueprints.cohesion_and_logic_formula: Evaluation Scope -> Accuracy Gain over Strongest Baselines -> Efficiency/Generalization Gain. 绑定逻辑规则：L010, L015.
focal_blueprints.defective_draft: We did comprehensive experiments on many datasets. The results show that our model beats all baselines by a large margin and is very fast.
focal_blueprints.defect_diagnosis_zh: 全段零数字（many datasets, a large margin, very fast），没有任何实质信息。
focal_blueprints.model_paragraph_en: We evaluate DyTS-Net across eight long-horizon forecasting benchmarks and a real-world wind-turbine telemetry system spanning 1,400 sensors. Across all prediction horizons up to 720 steps, DyTS-Net reduces MSE by 12.8% over PatchTST and 17.4% over iTransformer, with the largest gains emerging during sudden weather-front transitions. Furthermore, our architecture requires 45% fewer FLOPs than full channel-mixing Transformers and transfers zero-shot to newly deployed turbine units without fine-tuning.

focal_blueprints.title_zh: 主实验结果整体对比与核心胜出原因剖析段（Main Results Analysis）
focal_blueprints.user_intent_zh: 我这一段想解读主实验大表（Table 1）：既报告全局胜率，又挑出最有代表性的对比案例，解释为什么竞争对手在那里跌倒而我们稳赢。
focal_blueprints.when_to_use_zh: Experiments 第 4.2 节 Main Results
paragraph_move_structure: S1 [全局统治力概述 Overall Dominance]：Table 1 summarizes the multivariate forecasting results, where [Our Model] achieves the lowest error in [X] out of [Y] dataset-horizon configurations.

S2 [对比流派 1 的差距与原因 Contrast vs. Family 1]：Compared with channel-independent baselines such as [Baseline A], our method reduces average MSE by [X%] on [Dataset], where strong cross-sensor coupling is critical.

S3 [对比流派 2 在困难场景下的崩溃 Contrast vs. Family 2 under Hard Regime]：Furthermore, while [Baseline B] performs competitively at short horizons ($H=96$), its error escalates by [Y%] at $H=720$ due to [Failure Mechanism].
S4 [回扣本文核心机制 Mechanistic Confirmation]：By contrast, our [Core Module] bounds long-range drift, maintaining a [Z%] margin over the second-best baseline at $H=720$.
focal_blueprints.cohesion_and_logic_formula: Global Win Rate -> Advantage over Family A -> Resilience at Long Horizon vs. Family B -> Mechanistic Takeaway. 绑定逻辑规则：L015, L013, L010.
focal_blueprints.defective_draft: As shown in Table 1, our model gets the best MSE on ETTm1, ETTm2, Weather, and Traffic. On Weather dataset, our MSE is 0.165, which is 12% lower than PatchTST. On Traffic, our MSE is 0.382, which beats iTransformer. This proves our model is the best.
focal_blueprints.defect_diagnosis_zh: 典型的“报账式朗读表格”，只报数字不分析机理，末句 This proves our model is the best 毫无信息量。
focal_blueprints.model_paragraph_en: Table 1 reports the multivariate forecasting results, where DyTS-Net secures the lowest error in 25 out of 28 dataset-horizon configurations. Compared with channel-independent PatchTST, DyTS-Net reduces average MSE by 14.2% on the 862-channel Traffic benchmark, where modeling spatial-temporal congestion propagation across adjacent road sensors is critical. Furthermore, while variate-mixing iTransformer performs competitively at $H=96$, its MSE escalates by 68% at $H=720$ on volatile Weather series as unregularized cross-channel attention overfits transient wind gusts. By decoupling stationary phase coupling from neural-ODE scale projection, DyTS-Net suppresses long-horizon drift and maintains an 11.6% margin over the strongest baseline at $H=720$.

focal_blueprints.track_name_zh: 小作文与图表/数据综合写作：IELTS Task 1 / TOEFL Integrated / 科研趋势报告（BP25–BP32）
focal_blueprints.title_zh: 托福综合写作 / 学术争议正反交锋段（Point-by-Point Reading vs. Lecture Synthesis）
focal_blueprints.user_intent_zh: 我这一段想写托福综合写作（Integrated Writing）或文献争议交锋段：先用 1 句话精准概括阅读材料（或正方文献）的分论点，再用 2–3 句话详细呈现教授讲座（或反方实证）是如何釜底抽薪推翻该论点的。
focal_blueprints.when_to_use_zh: TOEFL Integrated Writing 主体段 / 论文理论争议辨析段
paragraph_move_structure: S1 [正方/阅读论点概括 Reading Claim & Rationale]：The reading passage contends that [Claim A], arguing that [Reading's Supporting Mechanism].
S2 [反方/听力直接反驳 Lecture Direct Refutation]：The lecturer directly challenges this assertion by pointing out that [Core Flaw / Neglected Factor in Reading's Premise].
S3 [反方具体反证展开 Empirical Counter-Evidence]：Specifically, she explains that when [Real-World Condition], [Mechanism B occurs instead], which [Negates the Claimed Benefit].
S4 [结论锁定 Refutation Closure]：Consequently, rather than achieving [Reading's Goal], the proposed measure actually exacerbates [Negative Outcome].
focal_blueprints.cohesion_and_logic_formula: Reading Claim -> Lecturer's Direct Challenge -> Specific Counter-Mechanism -> Reversed Outcome. 绑定逻辑规则：L008, L019.
focal_blueprints.defective_draft: The reading says that replacing all delivery trucks with autonomous drones will save energy. The professor disagrees. She says drones use a lot of battery to stay in the air and can only carry one package at a time.
focal_blueprints.defect_diagnosis_zh: 句式碎片化（The reading says... The professor disagrees. She says...），缺乏紧凑的逻辑因果嵌套。
focal_blueprints.model_paragraph_en: The reading passage contends that replacing urban delivery vans with autonomous quadcopter drones will substantially reduce last-mile transportation energy consumption, citing the lighter weight of aerial vehicles. The lecturer directly challenges this premise by examining energy efficiency per kilogram of delivered freight. Specifically, she points out that unlike ground vehicles supported passively by road surfaces, multi-rotor drones must expend continuous battery power simply to counteract gravity and headwinds while carrying only a single parcel per trip. Consequently, servicing a dense apartment block via individual drone flights consumes nearly three times more energy per package than a single consolidated van route.

focal_logic_rules.name_zh: 图尔敏五步微论证模型（Toulmin Micro-Argumentation）
focal_logic_rules.core_principle_zh: 任何一个独立成段的学术或议论主张，都必须具备完整的五要素：① 主张（Claim）、② 机理解释（Mechanism/Reason）、③ 实证数据或具象案例（Evidence）、④ 逻辑桥梁（Warrant：为什么该证据能证明该主张）、⑤ 边界限定（Qualification/Hedging）。
focal_logic_rules.structural_formula: [S1: Claim] -> [S2: Underlying Mechanism] -> [S3: Concrete Metric/Instance] -> [S4: Warrant/Implication] -> [S5: Boundary/Scope Qualification].
focal_logic_rules.common_pitfall_zh: 只有 Claim + 换句话重复一遍 Claim + 空洞夸张形容词，中间既无传导机制也无具象证据。
focal_logic_rules.bad_example_en: Patch-level tokenization is much better than point-wise tokenization. It captures local information very well and improves time series forecasting significantly in all cases.
focal_logic_rules.good_example_en: Patch-level tokenization outperforms point-wise representations in long-horizon time series forecasting [Claim]. Whereas single time steps lack semantic context and amplify high-frequency noise, contiguous sub-series patches preserve local slope and periodicity [Mechanism]. On the ETTm2 benchmark, grouping 16 consecutive steps reduces 720-step MSE by 18.7% compared with point-wise attention [Evidence]. This gain confirms that local structural aggregation mitigates attention dispersion over long lookback windows [Warrant], although excessively large patches may blur abrupt transient anomalies [Qualification].
focal_logic_rules.analysis_zh: 五句话各司其职：立论 -> 对比机理 -> ETTm2 实证数据 -> 理论印证 -> 诚实指出过大 Patch 的边界局限，无懈可击。

focal_logic_rules.name_zh: 公式与散文无缝咬合：先给直觉动机，后推符号定义（Intuition-Before-Math）
focal_logic_rules.core_principle_zh: 在 Methodology 段落中引入数学公式时，严禁突兀甩出 'The equation is defined as follows:'。必须遵循三步曲：① 物理/算法直觉（为什么要算这个量） -> ② 数学定义（把公式作为句子的语法宾语或同位语自然嵌入） -> ③ 关键符号的物理含义与边界。
focal_logic_rules.structural_formula: To [Intuitive Goal], we formulate [Concept] as: [Equation], where [Symbol A] denotes [Meaning] and [Symbol B] constrains [Boundary].
focal_logic_rules.common_pitfall_zh: 公式前后全是碎片句（Here is the formula: ... In the formula, x is input, y is output.），破坏段落连贯。
focal_logic_rules.bad_example_en: We use a gating weight. The formula is w = sigmoid(Wx + b). In this formula, x is the feature and w is the weight.
focal_logic_rules.good_example_en: To suppress high-frequency sensor jitter before temporal aggregation, we compute a channel-wise attenuation gate $g_t = \sigma(W_g h_t + b_g)$, where $h_t \in \mathbb{R}^d$ denotes the instantaneous hidden state and $g_t \in (0, 1)^d$ dynamically scales down noisy channels.
focal_logic_rules.analysis_zh: 一句话之内完成“目的状语（抑制高频抖动）+ 核心主谓宾（计算通道衰减门）+ 公式同位语 + where 定语从句解释符号维度与物理作用”，紧凑专业。

focal_revision_cases.domain_zh: 非平稳时间序列预测与分布漂移消除
focal_revision_cases.primary_defect_category: 头重脚轻长主语 + 散装短句堆砌（Top-Heavy Subject & Choppy Flow）
focal_revision_cases.communicative_goal_zh: 我这一段想在 Introduction 结尾前，用三句话硬核总结我们在哪些基准数据集/真实硬件上做了实验，取得了多大幅度的领先。
focal_revision_cases.original_defective_paragraph: We did comprehensive experiments on many datasets. The results show that our model beats all baselines by a large margin and is very fast.

seven_point_diagnosis_zh.1_controlling_idea: 原段中心论点被套话或碎片句淹没，首句未能直接立论。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.2_subject_length_and_balance: 存在【头重脚轻长主语 + 散装短句堆砌（Top-Heavy Subject & Choppy Flow）】：主语冗长或句子结构松散，违反尾重原则（L011）。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.3_given_to_new_flow: 句间缺乏旧信息向新信息的平滑过渡（违反 L006 图尔敏五步微论证模型（Toulmin Micro-Argumentation））。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.4_anaphora_and_connectors: 存在裸露的 This/It 指代或机械使用 First/Second/Moreover。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.5_colloquialism_and_ai_cliches: 全段零数字（many datasets, a large margin, very fast），没有任何实质信息。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.6_quantitative_or_instance_grounding: 缺乏 Metric-Baseline-Condition 三元组（L010）或具象行业微观案例（L021）。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.7_voice_and_constituent_clarity: 谓语动词弱化为 be/make/get/have，未发挥强及物动词的骨架支撑作用。

step_by_step_surgery_zh: 第一步【砍壳提主干】：删去句首 AI 修辞帽与口语词，将核心实体（≤5词）提作全句主语。
第二步【强动词替换】：将 is very bad / makes it good 替换为精准及物动词（degrades / stabilizes / decouples / reduces）。
第三步【咬合信息流】：在第二、三句句首使用 `This/Such + 汇总名词` 承接上一句宾语，形成 Given-to-New 锁链。
第四步【注入实证锚点】：补全具体评测指标、对比基线或微观工程场景，彻底消除空洞夸张。
focal_revision_cases.revised_idiomatic_paragraph_en: We evaluate DyTS-Net across eight long-horizon forecasting benchmarks and a real-world wind-turbine telemetry system spanning 1,400 sensors. Across all prediction horizons up to 720 steps, DyTS-Net reduces MSE by 12.8% over PatchTST and 17.4% over iTransformer, with the largest gains emerging during sudden weather-front transitions. Furthermore, our architecture requires 45% fewer FLOPs than full channel-mixing Transformers and transfers zero-shot to newly deployed turbine units without fine-tuning.

focal_revision_cases.domain_zh: 长序列 Transformer 稀疏注意力与分块表征
focal_revision_cases.primary_defect_category: 头重脚轻长主语 + 散装短句堆砌（Top-Heavy Subject & Choppy Flow）
focal_revision_cases.communicative_goal_zh: 我这一段想写动态折线图（或模型训练收敛曲线）的主体细节段：把一条经历“初期缓慢爬升 -> 中期爆发增长 -> 后期高位平台期”的曲线，以及另一条“冲高回落”的曲线对比写活。
focal_revision_cases.original_defective_paragraph: In 2000, A was 12% and B was 54%. Then in 2005, A increased to 15%. In 2018, A increased to 48%. In 2025, A was 47%. B increased to 61% in 2004, and then decreased to 24% in 2025.

seven_point_diagnosis_zh.1_controlling_idea: 原段中心论点被套话或碎片句淹没，首句未能直接立论。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.2_subject_length_and_balance: 存在【头重脚轻长主语 + 散装短句堆砌（Top-Heavy Subject & Choppy Flow）】：主语冗长或句子结构松散，违反尾重原则（L011）。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.3_given_to_new_flow: 句间缺乏旧信息向新信息的平滑过渡（违反 L026 生成模型三元权衡论证规范：生成质量、模式覆盖度与采样效率（Generative Trilemma Logic））。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.4_anaphora_and_connectors: 存在裸露的 This/It 指代或机械使用 First/Second/Moreover。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.5_colloquialism_and_ai_cliches: 典型的“流水账报年份数字”（In 2000... In 2005... In 2018...），句式单一且毫无趋势洞察。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.6_quantitative_or_instance_grounding: 缺乏 Metric-Baseline-Condition 三元组（L010）或具象行业微观案例（L021）。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.7_voice_and_constituent_clarity: 谓语动词弱化为 be/make/get/have，未发挥强及物动词的骨架支撑作用。

step_by_step_surgery_zh: 第一步【砍壳提主干】：删去句首 AI 修辞帽与口语词，将核心实体（≤5词）提作全句主语。
第二步【强动词替换】：将 is very bad / makes it good 替换为精准及物动词（degrades / stabilizes / decouples / reduces）。
第三步【咬合信息流】：在第二、三句句首使用 `This/Such + 汇总名词` 承接上一句宾语，形成 Given-to-New 锁链。
第四步【注入实证锚点】：补全具体评测指标、对比基线或微观工程场景，彻底消除空洞夸张。
focal_revision_cases.revised_idiomatic_paragraph_en: In 2000, battery-electric vehicles accounted for a mere 4% of municipal fleet purchases, trailing diesel buses at 62%. Following five years of marginal fluctuation, electric adoption accelerated sharply after 2006, quadrupling to 38% by 2018 before leveling off at approximately 41% through 2025. By contrast, diesel procurement peaked briefly at 67% in 2004 but subsequently underwent a sustained contraction, plunging to 19% by the end of the survey. This divergent trajectory reversed the initial 58-percentage-point deficit into a more than twofold lead for electric fleets.
